models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.summary: Complete songs conditioned on lyrics and a music description.
models.caveat: Open weights; non-streaming. Mac runtime must be qualified. Hosted music API access is restricted for new users.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.summary: Song generation and editing in an extensible local model family.
models.controls: Lyrics, reference audio, covers, repainting, LoRA
models.caveat: Official Mac support is documented. Measure quality and memory on this Mac before selecting defaults.

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Small Music
models.summary: Lightweight music generation with a documented Apple Silicon optimization path.
models.caveat: Code and model licenses are separate. A generated sample needs mapping and loop editing to become an instrument.

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Small SFX
models.summary: Generate percussion textures, objects, foley, and unusual sound material.
models.caveat: Sound generation is not a multisampled playable instrument. Verify checkpoint terms.

models.name: Stable Audio 3 Medium
models.summary: A larger audio and music generation candidate for a GPU worker.
models.caveat: The main runtime targets CUDA. Keep outside the Mac audio callback.

models.name: HeartMuLa
models.summary: Lyrics-and-tags music generation with a family of music understanding tools.
models.caveat: Use the published 3B checkpoint as the comparison baseline; internal-model claims are not shipping capability.

models.name: MuLaCover
models.summary: Generate covers or new arrangements from reference audio or melody and chord MIDI.
models.controls: Melody MIDI, chord MIDI, lyrics, style
models.caveat: Strong candidate for human score control. Code and model have separate license files.

models.name: YuE2
models.summary: A song generator with symbolic planning, covers, and score editing.
models.caveat: Documented starting configuration is Linux with NVIDIA BF16 and 24 GB VRAM. Use a worker rather than assuming native Mac operation.

models.name: LeVo 2 SongGeneration 2
models.summary: A comparison candidate for full songs and lyric adherence.
models.caveat: Upstream repository could not be read during this research pass. Verify release files, checkpoint license, and source availability before integration.

models.name: DiffRhythm 2
models.summary: Diffusion-based song generation with vocals and accompaniment.
models.caveat: Research candidate; qualify runtime and model terms separately.

models.name: Lyria 3.5
models.summary: Hosted song generation with vocals, song structure, and timed lyrics.
models.caveat: Requires an enabled Gemini API account and a spending limit; no cloud calls are enabled in this build.

models.name: Eleven Music v2.5
models.summary: Hosted music generation with composition plans, audio references, and inpainting.
models.controls: Composition plan, lyrics, reference audio, section edits
models.caveat: Commercial API and account terms apply. Finetunes are a separate offering.

models.name: Lyria RealTime
models.summary: Continuously steer instrumental music through a live streaming connection.
models.caveat: Experimental hosted model. Continuous audio output does not imply live microphone conditioning.

models.name: Magenta RealTime 2
models.summary: Open-weight live music generation with Apple Silicon model variants.
models.controls: Live audio and text steering, local streaming
models.caveat: Official small-model Mac support is promising; measure latency under simultaneous playing and recording.

models.name: MusicGen
models.summary: An established text-conditioned music generation baseline.
models.caveat: AudioCraft weights use CC BY NC 4.0. Keep research use separate from commercial product distribution.

models.name: MusicGen Melody
models.summary: Generate music guided by the melody of a reference recording.
models.caveat: Melody audio is different from editable MIDI conditioning. AudioCraft model weights are noncommercial.

models.name: JASCO
models.summary: Joint audio and symbolic conditioning for controllable generation.
models.caveat: Research comparison; inspect the specific checkpoint terms and version before use.

models.name: RoyalCities sample workflows
models.summary: A workflow toolkit for generating production-oriented sample material.
models.caveat: This is a toolkit and checkpoint ecosystem, not one model. Qualify each selected checkpoint and license.

models.name: DDSP
models.summary: Learn instrument timbre using differentiable synthesis components.
models.caveat: Useful for performance-controlled instruments; training data and a playable wrapper are still needed.

models.name: RAVE
models.summary: Realtime neural audio synthesis and timbre exploration with a learned latent space.
models.caveat: Experimental instrument direction; inspect model weights and runtime latency for each patch.

models.name: AudioLDM 2
models.summary: Text-to-audio and music generation with editing and inpainting research paths.
models.caveat: Lower-priority research baseline; checkpoint licensing and quality need qualification.

models.name: TangoFlux
models.summary: Fast text-to-audio synthesis for textures and sound design.
models.caveat: Evaluate isolated instruments and transients rather than assuming full-song performance.

models.name: DiffSinger
models.summary: Score-driven singing synthesis with explicit phoneme and musical controls.
models.caveat: Engine code, vocoder, and each voicebank can have different terms. Choir arrangement is an OmniuSong layer.

models.name: Seed-VC
models.summary: Voice and singing conversion guided by a reference performance.
models.controls: Reference voice, source singing, pitch controls
models.caveat: GPL code and checkpoint terms require review. Use voices you are authorized to use. Conversion does not write harmony.

models.name: HeartTranscriptor
models.summary: A lyrics-transcription model from the HeartMuLa family.
models.caveat: Singing transcription differs from ordinary speech recognition. Measure word accuracy before lyric alignment.

models.name: Spotify Basic Pitch
models.summary: Lightweight polyphonic note transcription with pitch bends, including voice recordings.
models.controls: One instrument or isolated vocal to notes
models.caveat: Best on one instrument at a time. Outputs MIDI 1; preserving estimated curves for MIDI 2 needs an adapter.

models.name: MuScriptor
models.summary: Multi-instrument transcription developed by Kyutai and Mirelo.
models.controls: Mixed music to separate instrumental note parts
models.caveat: A high-priority contemporary transcription candidate. Validate every checkpoint and its terms.

models.name: Magenta MT3
models.summary: Multi-task, multi-instrument transcription research baseline.
models.caveat: The original T5X stack has substantial environment requirements. Keep it in an isolated worker.

models.name: YourMT3 Plus
models.summary: A multi-task, multi-track transcription candidate.
models.caveat: GPL code; current executable code and checkpoint provenance must be pinned, rather than inferred from a demo.

models.name: Aria AMT
models.summary: Piano transcription candidate for expressive piano recordings.
models.caveat: Piano-specific. Keep alongside the general multi-instrument path.

models.name: Aria
models.summary: Expressive piano MIDI continuation with an official MLX implementation.
models.controls: Human MIDI phrase, continuation, expressive timing
models.caveat: A particularly good Mac-first candidate. MIDI 2 transport is an OmniuSong responsibility.

models.name: Anticipatory Music Transformer
models.summary: Compose symbolic music around constraints and existing musical events.
models.caveat: Research integration requires adapting its event vocabulary to the project note model.

models.name: HT Demucs
models.summary: Separate music into vocals, drums, bass and other parts.
models.caveat: The original Meta repository is archived. Pin the implementation and avoid presenting maintenance as active.

models.name: SAM Audio
models.summary: Isolate audio targets using text, spans, or visual prompts.
models.controls: A target sound description, audio, optional video
models.caveat: General source separation is useful for unusual material; code and model licensing need inspection.

models.name: Qwen family through Ollama
models.summary: Use an installed instruction model to draft and revise original lyrics.
models.controls: Theme, rhyme, syllable targets, structured lyrics
models.caveat: A general language model needs a song-specific evaluation. Model choice is explicit; the app never downloads one silently.

models.name: Other local instruction models
models.summary: Swap lyric and musical-planning models through a local Ollama adapter.
models.caveat: Ollama is a runtime, not a music model. Each installed model has its own license and quality profile.
